background.value: Fond blanc / white background ("Deux photos d'identité sur fond blanc" — Two identity photos on white background)

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Directorate General of National Documentation (DGDN), Togo's official passport-issuing authority (dgdn.gouv.tg). Its passport page states only quantity and background color for the identity photo ('Deux photos d'identité sur fond blanc') — no size, recency, expression, glasses, or headwear rule is given on this page. A separate DGDN sub-page (services.dgdn.gouv.tg/en/application) and the DGDN homepage were also checked and contained no additional photo specification. Togo's e-Visa portal (voyage.gouv.tg) has a much richer official photo standard (see tg-visa.json), but that applies to the visa product, not the passport, so it was not cross-applied here despite both being issued under the same government.
